title: Semantic Knowledge Projection Contract
key_changes: Replaced positional produce(evidence, optional sourceName) with typed project(input).
Projection input carries discriminated request, source evidence, canonical SourceFile, and SemanticEvidenceProvider.
Projection output keeps source identity, provider provenance, and canonical SemanticKnowledgeDataFlow together.
ControllerDataflowAst retains the complete source-correlated projection.
Removed the adapter parameter falsely propagated into canonicalDefinition although it was not consumed.
Preserved canonical invocation judgment and distinct integrated response composition.
